question: After the timeout defect and merge conflict are resolved, should every outbound Feishu video perform bounded cover extraction and an optional image upload to improve native preview rendering?
rationale: The feature improves visible video presentation but adds a subprocess and API request to every video send, so permanent adoption of that latency and operational cost needs Feishu-owner intent.

options.title: Adopt bounded previews
options.body: Merge after both extraction and optional upload have short deadlines and fallback coverage, preserving ordinary video delivery when either step fails.

options.title: Accept the long upload wait
options.body: Keep the shared 120-second image-upload timeout and explicitly accept that preview generation may substantially delay video delivery.

options.title: Decline automatic covers
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if maintainers do not want an additional subprocess and API request on every Feishu video.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded previews
recommendation.body: Merge after both extraction and optional upload have short deadlines and fallback coverage, preserving ordinary video delivery when either step fails.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad Feishu media-alignment history makes this the best available owner for the channel-level behavior and latency tradeoff.
